title: Travel English
tagline: Find your words along the way.
description: Practice the conversations that help a journey run smoothly. Prepare for airports, local transport, places to stay, meals out, and unexpected changes with practical sentences and polite requests.

chapters.title: Before you leave
chapters.description: Check travel details, pack essentials, and get ready for departure.

sentences.text: Our flight leaves early tomorrow morning.
sentences.hint: Give the timing of an upcoming departure by air.

sentences.text: I keep my passport in an inside pocket.
sentences.hint: Explain where you store an important travel document.

sentences.text: We need to check the baggage allowance.
sentences.hint: Say you must find out how much luggage is permitted.

sentences.text: Does this fare include a checked bag?
sentences.hint: Ask whether the ticket price covers luggage in the hold.

sentences.text: I am packing a light jacket for the evenings.
sentences.hint: Describe taking an extra layer for later in the day.

sentences.text: Our hotel booking is for three nights.
sentences.hint: State the length of your accommodation reservation.

sentences.text: Can you send me a copy of the tickets?
sentences.hint: Ask someone to share your travel documents.

sentences.text: I need an adapter for my phone charger.
sentences.hint: Explain that your charging equipment needs a different plug connection.

sentences.text: We are taking the first bus to the airport.
sentences.hint: Describe using the earliest bus for your departure.

sentences.text: Let's check the address before we leave.
sentences.hint: Suggest confirming the location before setting off.

chapters.title: At the airport
chapters.description: Navigate check-in, security, seat choices, and boarding.

sentences.text: Where can I find the check-in desk?
sentences.hint: Ask where to register for your flight.

sentences.text: I'd prefer an aisle seat, please.
sentences.hint: Request a place beside the walkway on the plane.

sentences.text: Do I need to take my laptop out of my bag?
sentences.hint: Ask whether security requires removing your computer.

sentences.text: This suitcase is my only checked bag.
sentences.hint: Explain that just one piece of luggage goes in the hold.

sentences.text: Can I keep this small backpack with me?
sentences.hint: Ask to carry a little bag into the cabin.

sentences.text: The departure board says our gate is twelve.
sentences.hint: Report the boarding location shown on the airport screen.

sentences.text: Our flight is boarding in twenty minutes.
sentences.hint: Say how soon passengers will start getting on the plane.

sentences.text: May I fill my water bottle after security?
sentences.hint: Ask about getting drinking water beyond the checkpoint.

sentences.text: Is this the line for priority boarding?
sentences.hint: Check whether a queue is for passengers who enter first.

sentences.text: Please let me know when my group can board.
sentences.hint: Ask staff to tell you when it is your turn.

chapters.title: On the move
chapters.description: Buy tickets, understand routes, and ask for help on local transport.

sentences.text: Which platform does the city train leave from?
sentences.hint: Ask where to wait for a train into town.

sentences.text: I'd like two single tickets to the central station.
sentences.hint: Request a pair of one-way fares to the main station.

sentences.text: Is there a cheaper ticket for children?
sentences.hint: Ask about reduced fares for young passengers.

sentences.text: Do we need to change trains at the next station?
sentences.hint: Check whether your route requires a transfer soon.

sentences.text: This bus stops outside our hotel.
sentences.hint: Explain that the route serves your accommodation directly.

sentences.text: Could you tell me when we reach the market?
sentences.hint: Ask someone to point out your destination on arrival.

sentences.text: The ticket machine won't accept my coins.
sentences.hint: Explain that your cash payment is not working.

sentences.text: How long does the journey usually take?
sentences.hint: Ask about the normal travel time.

sentences.text: Please stop at the next corner.
sentences.hint: Tell a driver where you would like to get out.

sentences.text: We got on the wrong tram, so we need to go back.
sentences.hint: Explain a route mistake and the need to return.

chapters.title: A place to stay
chapters.description: Check into a hotel, confirm room details, and request practical help.

sentences.text: I have a reservation for two nights.
sentences.hint: Tell reception the length of your booked stay.

sentences.text: Could we check in a little early?
sentences.hint: Ask to enter your room before the usual arrival time.

sentences.text: We booked a room with two separate beds.
sentences.hint: Explain that your reservation is for twin beds.

sentences.text: Is breakfast included in the room price?
sentences.hint: Check whether the morning meal costs extra.

sentences.text: I'd like a quiet room away from the lift.
sentences.hint: Request accommodation with less noise from the elevator area.

sentences.text: What time does the reception desk close?
sentences.hint: Ask when front-desk staff finish for the day.

sentences.text: The key card doesn't seem to work.
sentences.hint: Report a problem unlocking your room.

sentences.text: Could you bring an extra towel to our room?
sentences.hint: Politely request another item for drying yourself.

sentences.text: We can't connect to the hotel's Wi-Fi.
sentences.hint: Explain that the accommodation's internet is not accessible.

sentences.text: We would like to stay one more night.
sentences.hint: Ask to extend your visit by a day.

chapters.title: Finding your way
chapters.description: Ask for directions, follow landmarks, and check accessible routes.

sentences.text: Excuse me, is the art museum within walking distance?
sentences.hint: Politely ask whether a cultural attraction is close enough on foot.

sentences.text: How do I get to the nearest pharmacy?
sentences.hint: Ask for a route to the closest place selling medicine.

sentences.text: Should I turn left at the traffic lights?
sentences.hint: Check a direction at a road signal.

sentences.text: The entrance is opposite the fountain.
sentences.hint: Locate the way in across from a water feature.

sentences.text: Go straight ahead until you reach the bridge.
sentences.hint: Give directions using a river crossing as the next landmark.

sentences.text: You need to cross the street at the next crossing.
sentences.hint: Direct someone to a nearby pedestrian crossing point.

sentences.text: Is there a step-free route to the station?
sentences.hint: Ask for a way to the trains without stairs.

sentences.text: I think we walked past the right street.
sentences.hint: Say you may have missed your turning.

sentences.text: Could you show me where we are on this map?
sentences.hint: Ask someone to mark your current location.

sentences.text: The old town is closer than it looks.
sentences.hint: Say the historic area is not as far away as it seems.

chapters.title: Eating out
chapters.description: Order a meal, explain food needs, and handle the bill politely.

sentences.text: Could we have a table for two near the window?
sentences.hint: Request seating for a pair beside a view outside.

sentences.text: I'd like the vegetable soup to start.
sentences.hint: Choose soup made with vegetables as your first course.

sentences.text: Does the grilled fish come with rice?
sentences.hint: Check which side dish accompanies a seafood meal.

sentences.text: Could you leave the cheese out of my salad?
sentences.hint: Ask for a dairy ingredient to be omitted.

sentences.text: I am allergic to peanuts, so I need to check the ingredients.
sentences.hint: Explain a food allergy and the need to know what a dish contains.

sentences.text: Would you recommend a local dish without meat?
sentences.hint: Ask for advice about a regional vegetarian option.

sentences.text: The food is lovely, but this isn't what I ordered.
sentences.hint: Politely point out that you received the wrong meal.

sentences.text: Could I have some tap water, please?
sentences.hint: Request drinking water rather than a bottled drink.

sentences.text: Can we pay for our meals separately?
sentences.hint: Ask to split payment between diners.

sentences.text: Is the service charge already included in the bill?
sentences.hint: Check whether a fee for table service is in the total.

chapters.title: Out exploring
chapters.description: Plan visits, ask about tours, and describe things you discovered.

sentences.text: What time is the last entry to the castle?
sentences.hint: Ask how late visitors can enter a historic building.

sentences.text: Do we need to book the guided tour in advance?
sentences.hint: Check whether you must reserve a group visit beforehand.

sentences.text: We'd like to visit the museum before it gets busy.
sentences.hint: Explain a preference for seeing the exhibits without crowds.

sentences.text: Is the audio guide available in English?
sentences.hint: Ask whether a recorded explanation comes in your chosen language.

sentences.text: Are visitors allowed to take photos inside?
sentences.hint: Check whether indoor photography is permitted.

sentences.text: How much time should we allow for the walk?
sentences.hint: Ask how long to set aside for a route on foot.

sentences.text: We followed the riverside path and found a quiet garden.
sentences.hint: Describe discovering a peaceful place beside the water.

sentences.text: The entrance ticket is valid for the whole day.
sentences.hint: Explain that admission covers the entire day.

sentences.text: Could you suggest somewhere nearby to sit and rest?
sentences.hint: Ask for a local place to take a break.

sentences.text: The tour was shorter than we expected, but we enjoyed it.
sentences.hint: Describe a pleasant visit that took less time than anticipated.

chapters.title: Shopping and paying
chapters.description: Choose souvenirs, ask about sizes, and clarify purchases or payments.

sentences.text: I'm looking for a small gift that is easy to carry.
sentences.hint: Ask for help choosing a portable present.

sentences.text: Do you have this scarf in a darker color?
sentences.hint: Ask for the same accessory in a deeper shade.

sentences.text: May I try these shoes in a larger size?
sentences.hint: Request a bigger pair to check the fit.

sentences.text: How much does it cost to send this parcel abroad?
sentences.hint: Ask the price of posting a package to another country.

sentences.text: Could you wrap this cup carefully for the journey?
sentences.hint: Ask for protective packaging around a fragile purchase.

sentences.text: I think you charged me for three postcards instead of two.
sentences.hint: Point out a possible mistake in the number of items billed.

sentences.text: Can I return this if it doesn't fit?
sentences.hint: Check the return policy for an unsuitable size.

sentences.text: The cash machine kept my card.
sentences.hint: Report that an ATM did not return your bank card.

sentences.text: Could you write the total down for me?
sentences.hint: Ask to see the final price in writing.

sentences.text: I'd prefer to pay in the local currency.
sentences.hint: Choose the destination's money rather than a converted amount.

chapters.title: When plans change
chapters.description: Explain lost belongings, travel disruptions, and problems that need assistance.

sentences.text: I left my backpack on the bus about an hour ago.
sentences.hint: Explain when and where you forgot a bag.

sentences.text: It is a dark green bag with a yellow handle.
sentences.hint: Describe the colors of a missing item.

sentences.text: Where can I report a lost passport?
sentences.hint: Ask where to notify someone about a missing travel document.

sentences.text: Our train was canceled, and we need another way to get there.
sentences.hint: Explain that a canceled service means finding different transport.

sentences.text: Can I use this ticket on a later service?
sentences.hint: Check whether your fare is valid for a different departure.

sentences.text: The room was noisy last night, so I couldn't sleep.
sentences.hint: Explain that sounds disturbed your rest at the hotel.

sentences.text: Could we move to a different room if one is available?
sentences.hint: Request an accommodation change if the hotel has space.

sentences.text: I have a sore throat and would like to speak to a pharmacist.
sentences.hint: Describe a symptom and ask for professional advice at a pharmacy.

sentences.text: My phone has run out of battery, and I need to contact my hotel.
sentences.hint: Explain that a dead phone prevents an important call.

sentences.text: Could you help me call a taxi to the clinic?
sentences.hint: Ask for assistance arranging transport to medical care.

chapters.title: Heading home
chapters.description: Coordinate departure, make final requests, and reflect on the journey.

sentences.text: Could we settle the hotel bill before breakfast?
sentences.hint: Ask to finish paying for your stay early in the morning.

sentences.text: Please keep our bags here until we return this afternoon.
sentences.hint: Request luggage storage while you go out for a few hours.

sentences.text: Can you arrange a taxi large enough for four people and our luggage?
sentences.hint: Ask for a vehicle with space for your group and bags.

sentences.text: We need to leave earlier because the roads may be busy.
sentences.hint: Explain that possible traffic means setting off sooner.

sentences.text: Could you confirm which terminal our flight leaves from?
sentences.hint: Ask someone to verify the correct airport building.

sentences.text: I'd like to change my seat if there is one by the window.
sentences.hint: Request a different place on the plane if a window seat is free.

sentences.text: Do we have enough time to catch our connecting flight?
sentences.hint: Check whether you can reach the next plane before departure.

sentences.text: Is there anything I need to declare at customs?
sentences.hint: Ask whether you must officially report any goods you are carrying.

sentences.text: The journey took longer than we planned, but we arrived safely.
sentences.hint: Describe a slow trip that ended without harm.

sentences.text: Next time, we are going to stay a little longer.
sentences.hint: Plan to give a future visit more time.
